ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   B. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   D. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   B. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

12. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   C. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Battle of Badr and Uhud 04 7.2 Treaty of Hudaybiya 03 7.3 Conquest of Makkah 07  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Battles of Badr and Uhud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Treaty of Hudaybiya 03 7.3 Conquest of Makkah 07 7.4 Farewell Pilgrimage 03 Tota and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Treaty of Hudaibiya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
